data.name: Khushdel
data.gender_notes: Khushdel is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bringer of Happiness and Delight. The name Khushdel carries the meaning “Delight, Joy, Happiness” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Khushdel usually hope their child will grow to embody delight, joy, happiness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To bring happiness and joy to others
data.etymology: Khushdel belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delight, Joy, Happiness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khushdel total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: خوشدل
in_arabic.meaning: خوش دل سے مراد ہے خوشحال دل والا
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم خوشدل کا مطلب ہے خوشحال دل والا، وہ شخص جس کا دل خوشیاں اور امیدوں سے بھرپور ہو۔ یہ نام قرآن میں نہیں ملتا، لیکن عربی زبان میں 'خوش' (خ و ش) اور 'دل' (د ل) کی ترکیب سے بنتا ہے۔ اسلامی تقالید میں، یہ نام روحانی خوشی اور اندرونی سکون کی علامت ہے۔

in_urdu.name: خوشدل
in_urdu.meaning: خوش دل meaning خوشحال دل والا، مسرور شخص
in_urdu.long_meaning: خوشدل نام کا معنی ہے خوشحال دل والا، وہ شخص جس کے دل میں مسرت اور امید کی گہرائی ہو۔ یہ نام عربی جڑوں سے نکلا ہے، جہاں 'خوش' کا مطلب ہے 'خوشی' اور 'دل' کا مطلب ہے 'دل'۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلم معاشرے میں، یہ نام روحانی خوشی، امید، اور اندرونی سکون کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: खुशदिल
in_hindi.meaning: खुशदिल का अर्थ है खुशहाल दिल वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: खुशदिल नाम का अर्थ है खुशहाल दिल वाला, वह व्यक्ति जिसके दिल में खुशियाँ और उम्मीदें भरी हुई हैं। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से निकला है, जहां 'खुश' का अर्थ है 'खुशी' और 'दिल' का अर्थ है 'दिल'। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम आध्यात्मिक खुशी, आशा, और आंतरिक शांति का प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: خوشدل
in_pashto.meaning: خوش دل د خوښۍ او اميد سره يو ځایګاه
in_pashto.long_meaning: خوشدل نوم معنی دے خوښۍ او اميد سره يو ځایګاه، هغه کسي چې د ده په زړه کې خوښۍ او امید ډک دي. دا نوم عربي ريښو څخه اخستل شوی دی، چیرته چې 'خوش' د 'خوشۍ' معنی لري او 'دل' د 'زړه' معنی لري. په افغان او پښتون دود کې، دا نوم روحاني خوښۍ، امید، او باطني سولې نښه ده.

in_english.name: Khushdel
in_english.long_meaning: Khushdel is an Islamic name meaning happy hearted or joyful person. It originates from Arabic roots 'khush' (خوش) meaning 'happiness' and 'del' (دل) meaning 'heart'. Although not directly mentioned in the Quran, the name signifies spiritual happiness, hope, and inner peace. Historically, it has been used across various Muslim cultures to denote someone with a cheerful and optimistic personality. The name is associated with positive traits such as joy, kindness, and warmth.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل خوش دل

data.cultural_impact: The name "Khushdel" in Persian/Urdu language means "Bringer of Happiness and Delight." This name is reflective of the Islamic culture's emphasis on inner and outer joy and happiness. In many Islamic traditions, it is believed that true happiness and contentment come from living a virtuous and pious life, following the teachings of Islam, and seeking closeness to Allah (God). This name serves as a reminder of the Islamic belief that a happy and contented person is a person who is living in accordance with God's will and pleasing Him through his actions.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Khushdel" also has significant spiritual significance in the Islamic tradition. It is a reminder of the belief that true happiness and joy come from within, from a deep sense of inner peace and contentment. It is a reminder of the Islamic teachings that encourage individuals to strive for self-improvement, seek knowledge, and live a pious and virtuous life. Additionally, the name "Khushdel" is a reminder of the belief that Allah is the ultimate source of happiness and joy, and that seeking closeness to Him is the best way to find peace and contentment in life. In essence, the name "Khushdel" is a reminder of the Islamic teachings that encourage individuals to live a virtuous and pious life in order to find true happiness and joy, both in this world and in the hereafter.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Delight, Joy, Happiness" symbolizes Bringer of Happiness and Delight. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Khushdel serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of delight, joy, happiness.
